SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch / Station 5
CONFIDENTIAL
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE FILE AND REGISTRY No. S. B. D 8488 (C) 40）
Date May 18, 40.
Subject Zang Nyoh-teing (常玉清), Chairman of An Ching League (安清全盟会).
Made by. D.I. Kuh Pao hwa Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford

It has been learnt from a confidential source
that Zang Ngoh Tsing arrived in Shanghai from Nanking
about the middle of March, 1940 and stayed in a
dwelling house at 184 Chih Shing Li (浙兴里) off
Dixwell Road, O.O.L. He returned to Nanking on
March 29, 1940. It is stated that he was here
for the purpose of reorganizing his Huang Dao
Society (now known as the An Ching League) in
opposition to the Special Service Corps of the
Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National
Salvation Corps at 76 Jessfield Road.
Information at hand indicates that he is now
Chairman of the An Tsing League, the headquarters
of which was officially inaugurated at Nanking on
May 14, 1940.

Kuh Pao hwa
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处档案与登记处 编号 S. B. D 8488 (C) 40）
日期 1940年5月18日。
事由 安清全盟会主席常玉清（Zang Nyoh-teing）。
制作人 督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao hwa） 转呈人 督察克劳福德（Crawford）

据密报获悉，常玉清（Zang Ngoh Tsing）于1940年3月中旬从南京抵达上海，居住在越界筑路区狄思威路（Dixwell Road）旁浙兴里184号的一处住宅内。他于1940年3月29日返回南京。据悉，他此次来沪旨在重组其黄道会（现称安清全盟会），以对抗位于极司菲尔路76号的国民党中国反共救国团特别服务队。

现有情报显示，他现任安清联盟主席，该联盟总部已于1940年5月14日在南京正式成立。

顾宝华
督察

副督察长（特别科）
